text JSON-encoded, wrapped in quotes and with `\n` escapes in place of line breaks. pit only decodes `params` that look like a JSON object or array, and only when the program can't take a string. Here it could take a string, so pit passed the encoded text through unchanged and `gh pr create --body` posted it as is. The agent's next step, which filled in the PR number, read that body back and saved it again without decoding it.

This has only happened once. Of the last 30 PRs, #76 is the only one whose body starts with `"`.

**How to stop it.** The fix goes in `cv/pit`, in `resolveToolInput` (`src/tool/input.ts`). When `params` is a quoted JSON string, pit should decode it, whatever input type the program declares.
